deep_dive.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
deep_dive.abstract: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, use high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines overcomplete equal-norm tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: a Flat Randomized Response version and a Metric-Aware Laplace version, the latter being better suited to higher codebook bit-width regimes. We show that SSTQ achieves optimal mean squared error scaling while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per client, where $N = Θ(d)$ is the frame size. We also derive a surrogate privacy-aware codebook objective that reduces the codebook-dependent MSE scaling from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Finally, we empirically evaluate SSTQ against established baselines on federated learning tasks using CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes SSTQ, a privacy-preserving vector quantization framework using tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware quantization, achieving near-optimal MSE scaling with only logarithmic communication bits in distributed optimization.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对分布式优化中通信开销大与隐私易泄露的问题，现有向量量化方法如vqSGD存在维度相关的方差问题。本文提出SSTQ框架，结合超完备等范数紧框架、坐标子采样与隐私感知的一维量化，在实现本地差分隐私的同时显著降低通信成本。实验表明SSTQ在均方误差上达到最优缩放，且只需约log2N+1比特，证明其在高比特率码本下同样有效。该工作为大规模分布式训练提供了一种兼顾隐私与通信效率的通用量化方案。
